title.zh: Binance Will Add 4 bStocks Tokenized Securities as Collateral Asset - 2026-10-07
title.en: Binance Will Add 4 bStocks Tokenized Securities as Collateral Asset - 2026-10-07

current_state.zh: Binance is adding four Securitize-issued bStocks tokenized securities (SECZB, USDEB, JPMB, LLYB) as eligible collateral across Cross Margin, Portfolio Margin and Portfolio Margin Pro, with corresponding margin trading pairs enabled at 2026-10-07 12:00 UTC.
